ranked_facts.concept_key: unilateral purulent discharge mixed with blood
ranked_facts.why: The presence of unilateral purulent discharge mixed with blood is more likely to be associated with a nasal foreign body, which would cause a localized infection, than with other candidates such as infectious processes of the nasal cavity, inflammatory processes, or neoplastic processes.

The unilaterality of symptoms suggests a localized cause such as a foreign body in the nasal cavity, which is more consistent with anatomical obstruction than with infectious, inflammatory, or neoplastic processes that might present with more bilateral or diffuse symptoms.
